name: Canadian Salad
summary: A 6-hand compendium trick-taking game where players try to avoid taking tricks, hearts, queens, the king of spades and the last trick.
rules_text: Play 6 hands in fixed order with a standard 52-card deck. Deal all cards evenly; for 3-6 players remove 2-4 low clubs/diamonds as needed. No trumps. Players must follow suit if able, otherwise may discard. Highest card of led suit wins trick and leads next. Hand objectives for penalty points: 1) No tricks: 10 per trick. 2) No hearts: 10 per heart taken. 3) No queens: 25 per queen. 4) No king of spades: 100 to its taker. 5) No last trick: 100 to last trick winner. 6) Combination: all penalties above apply together. Track penalties each hand; after six hands lowest total wins, total 1120 points across all players.
rating_reason: Compendium avoidance trick-taking game, fixed sequence, strategic.
